summary: The retired educator advocates for the continuation of the E-Rate program to ensure access in underserved communities.

claims.argument: Continuation is necessary to maintain access in underserved communities
claims.evidence_quote: As a retired educator who spent a career teaching in both K-12 and higher education as well as conducting educational research I strongly urge the continuation of this program, which provides important access in communities where such access is very limited or not available at all.
